title: 2020 roadmap on pore materials for energy and environmental applications
claim: Organic-linker modification can tune MOF light absorption when a MOF is used as a photoelectrochemical photosensitizer.
explanation: The review describes electron-donating amino groups narrowing the gap and extending absorption toward visible light in Ti-based MOF-containing structures.
scope: MOF photosensitizers and semiconductor–MOF heterostructures for photoelectrochemistry.
conditions: The modified linker must participate in light harvesting and subsequent charge transfer.
caveats: The direction of the reported absorption change is supported by the cited Ti-based systems, not every linker or MOF.
